# The run lifecycle: variables, codebases, pre- and post-processing, hooks, budgets

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-workflow-skill.ts from @generatorai/workflow-spec. Do not edit. The hand-written parts live in scripts/workflow-skill/. -->

A run goes through one lifecycle, whoever starts it (the app, the CLI, an automation, a chat, an MCP client):

- **starting**, in order, each phase journalled (a crash resumes at the phase that did not finish):

1. `workspace`
2. `worktrees`
3. `uploads`
4. `projectConfigs`
5. `preprocess`
6. `sandbox`

- **running**: the stages.
- **finalizing** (or cancelling), in order:

1. `compensate`
2. `hooks`
3. `postProcess`
4. `release`

## Variables

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string `^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$` (1..64 chars) | yes |  | Identifier referenced as variables.<name> (or bare {{name}} in templates) |
| `type` | 'string' \| 'number' \| 'boolean' \| 'choice' \| 'text' \| 'list' \| 'json' | yes |  | Value type; choice restricts the value to `options`; list is a list of strings; json is any JSON value |
| `label` | string (1..200 chars) | yes |  | Label shown in the run form |
| `description` | string (≤2000 chars) |  |  | Help text shown in the run form |
| `required` | boolean |  | `false` | Whether a run must supply a value (or rely on the default) |
| `defaultValue` | any |  |  | Value used when a run supplies none; must match `type` |
| `options` | string (1..200 chars)[] (≤100) |  |  | Allowed values of a choice variable |

- Reserved roots, never variable names: `variables`, `stages`, `run`, `loop`, `loops`, `item`, `map`, `maps`, `parent`, `child`.
- Forbidden prefixes: names matching `^(__|repo_path_|repo_branch_)`.
- Variable types: `string`, `number`, `boolean`, `choice`, `text`, `list`, `json`.

- Reference a variable as `variables.<name>` in expressions, or `{{name}}` / `{{variables.name}}` in templates.
- `required: true` with no `defaultValue` means every run must supply it; a variable that is neither required nor
  defaulted is nullable in expressions (test it with `exists(variables.x)` or `coalesce`).
- A `choice` variable needs `options`; `list` is a list of strings (a map can fan out over it); `json` is any JSON.
- Never ask for secrets as variables. Tokens and keys are `secretref:<name>` references in the fields that take
  them (MCP headers and env, hook env, `session.provider.apiKey`).

## Codebases and worktrees

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `codebaseAliases` | string `^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$` (1..50 chars)[] (≤5) |  | `[]` | Project codebases the run mounts; exposed as run.codebases.<alias> |
| `useWorktree` | boolean |  | `true` | Mount codebases as isolated worktrees rather than in place |
| `requiresCodebase` | boolean |  | `false` | Refuse to start without at least one codebase |
| `sandbox` | 'required' \| 'optional' |  | `"required"` | When the deployment runs stages in a sandbox: required fails the run if the sandbox cannot start; optional runs on the host instead |
| `preprocessingSteps` | object[] (≤50) |  | `[]` | Steps run before any stage |
| `preprocessingSteps[].name` | string (1..200 chars) | yes |  | Display name |
| `preprocessingSteps[].failOnError` | boolean |  | `true` | Fail the run when the step fails |
| `preprocessingSteps[].config` | one of (by `type`) | yes |  | What the step does |
| `preprocessingSteps[].config.type` | "clone_repo" | yes |  | Prepare a checkout of a codebase |
| `preprocessingSteps[].config.repoAlias` | string `^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$` (1..50 chars) | yes |  | Alias of a project codebase |
| `preprocessingSteps[].config.type` | "run_script" | yes |  | Run a shell script |
| `preprocessingSteps[].config.script` | string (1..20000 chars) | yes |  | Shell script; a literal (templates are rejected, variables arrive as GEN_VAR_* environment variables) |
| `preprocessingSteps[].config.cwd` | string (≤1000 chars) |  |  | Working directory, relative to the run workspace |
| `preprocessingSteps[].config.timeoutMs` | integer (≥1000, ≤3600000) |  |  | Timeout (default 60 s) |
| `preprocessingSteps[].config.type` | "validate_input" | yes |  | Check an input variable |
| `preprocessingSteps[].config.variableName` | string (1..64 chars) | yes |  | Variable to check |
| `preprocessingSteps[].config.rules` | one of (by `type`)[] (≤20) | yes |  | Rules, all of which must pass |
| `preprocessingSteps[].config.rules[].type` | "required" | yes |  | The variable has a non-empty value |
| `preprocessingSteps[].config.rules[].message` | string (1..1000 chars) | yes |  | Error shown when the rule fails |
| `preprocessingSteps[].config.rules[].type` | "regex" | yes |  | The value matches `pattern` (linear-time engine) |
| `preprocessingSteps[].config.rules[].pattern` | string (1..1000 chars) | yes |  | Pattern without slashes |
| `preprocessingSteps[].config.rules[].flags` | string `^[ims]{0,3}$` |  |  | Flags: i, m, s |
| `preprocessingSteps[].config.rules[].type` | "min_length" | yes |  | The value has at least `value` characters |
| `preprocessingSteps[].config.rules[].value` | integer (≥0, ≤1000000) | yes |  | Minimum length |
| `preprocessingSteps[].config.rules[].type` | "max_length" | yes |  | The value has at most `value` characters |
| `preprocessingSteps[].config.rules[].value` | integer (≥0, ≤1000000) | yes |  | Maximum length |
| `preprocessingSteps[].config.type` | "set_variable" | yes |  | Set a variable for the rest of the run |
| `preprocessingSteps[].config.variableName` | string (1..64 chars) | yes |  | Variable to set (a declared or a new one) |
| `preprocessingSteps[].config.value` | string (≤100000 chars) | yes |  | Value, a template |
| `preprocessingSteps[].config.type` | "conditional" | yes |  | Run steps depending on an expression |
| `preprocessingSteps[].config.condition` | string (1..2000 chars) | yes |  | Boolean expression over variables |
| `preprocessingSteps[].config.thenSteps` | object[] (≤20) | yes |  | Steps run when the condition is true |
| `preprocessingSteps[].config.elseSteps` | object[] (≤20) |  |  | Steps run otherwise |
| `postProcessing` | object |  | `{}` | What happens after the stages complete |
| `postProcessing.autoCommit` | boolean |  | `false` | Commit the changes when the run completes |
| `postProcessing.autoPush` | boolean |  | `false` | Push the work branch after committing |
| `postProcessing.autoCreatePR` | boolean |  | `false` | Open a pull request (implies commit and push) |
| `postProcessing.steps` | object[] (≤50) |  | `[]` | Extra steps, all run in order |
| `postProcessing.steps[].name` | string (1..200 chars) | yes |  | Display name |
| `postProcessing.steps[].failOnError` | boolean |  | `true` | Fail the run when the step fails |
| `postProcessing.steps[].config` | one of (by `type`) | yes |  | What the step does |
| `postProcessing.steps[].config.type` | "commit_and_push" | yes |  | Commit the run changes and optionally push |
| `postProcessing.steps[].config.repoAlias` | string `^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$` (1..50 chars) |  |  | Alias of a project codebase |
| `postProcessing.steps[].config.commitMessage` | string (1..100000 chars) | yes |  | Commit message, a template |
| `postProcessing.steps[].config.push` | boolean |  |  | Push after committing |
| `postProcessing.steps[].config.generateMessage` | boolean |  |  | Let an agent write the message |
| `postProcessing.steps[].config.baseBranch` | string (≤200 chars) |  |  | Branch the work branch is based on |
| `postProcessing.steps[].config.type` | "create_pr" | yes |  | Open a pull request |
| `postProcessing.steps[].config.title` | string (1..100000 chars) | yes |  | Title, a template |
| `postProcessing.steps[].config.body` | string (≤100000 chars) | yes |  | Body, a template |
| `postProcessing.steps[].config.baseBranch` | string (≤200 chars) |  |  | Target branch |
| `postProcessing.steps[].config.generateText` | boolean |  |  | Let an agent write the title and body |
| `postProcessing.steps[].config.draft` | boolean |  |  | Open as a draft |
| `postProcessing.steps[].config.type` | "run_script" | yes |  | Run a shell script |
| `postProcessing.steps[].config.script` | string (1..20000 chars) | yes |  | Shell script; a literal (templates are rejected, variables arrive as GEN_VAR_* environment variables) |
| `postProcessing.steps[].config.cwd` | string (≤1000 chars) |  |  | Working directory, relative to the run workspace |
| `postProcessing.steps[].config.timeoutMs` | integer (≥1000, ≤3600000) |  |  | Timeout (default 60 s) |

- The run mounts the codebases the run request names, else `lifecycle.codebaseAliases`; never every codebase of
  the project. With `requiresCodebase: true` a run without one is refused.
- `useWorktree: true` (the default) gives the run its own worktree per codebase, on its own branch, so the
  user's checkout is never touched. `in_place` mounts need `admin:settings` at run time.
- Stages read a codebase's location as `run.codebases.<alias>.{path, branch, baseRef}`; never as a variable.
- Worktrees are not deleted when a run ends; retention reclaims them.
- `sandbox: "required"` fails the run if the deployment's sandbox cannot start; `"optional"` runs on the host.

## Preprocessing

`lifecycle.preprocessingSteps` run before any stage: `clone_repo`, `run_script` (command-bearing), `validate_input`
(rules on a variable), `set_variable` (a template) and `conditional` (an expression over variables, with then and
else steps). Prefer `validate_input` to check inputs early; avoid `run_script` unless the user asks for it.

## Post-processing: commits, pushes and pull requests

- `autoCommit` commits the run's changes when the run **completes**; `autoPush` pushes the work branch;
  `autoCreatePR` opens a pull request (it implies commit and push).
- `steps` add explicit `commit_and_push`, `create_pr` or `run_script` steps (messages and titles are templates).
- A failed or cancelled run commits nothing. So the safe gate before a push or PR is `approval` on the last stage:
  a rejection fails the run (see `stages.md`). Do not add an `on: "failure"` edge from that stage, or a rejection
  becomes a handled failure and the run completes and pushes.
- A sub-workflow with `workspace: "inherit"` skips its own post-processing; the parent commits.
- Tell the user, before submitting, whether the workflow commits, pushes or opens a PR.

## Hooks, onExit and onFailure

Hooks run a `script`, an `http` call or a `function` at a lifecycle phase. They are command-bearing: saving a
workflow that adds or changes one needs `admin:settings`. Add them only when the user asks.

- `failurePolicy`: `abort` fails the owner, `skip` (the default) ignores the failure, `continue` logs and proceeds.
- `type` must equal `config.type` (`hook-type-mismatch`); hook ids are unique per list.
- Script hooks take literal `command` and `args`; values go through `env`.
- `workflow.onFailure` actions run when the run finalizes as failed, then `workflow.onExit` actions run whatever
  the outcome.

Stage hook phases (`stages[].hooks[].phase`):

| Phase | Category | When |
|---|---|---|
| `pre_run` | stage | Before the stage attempt starts |
| `post_run` | stage | After the stage attempt finishes |
| `pre_prompt` | prompt | Before a prompt is sent to the agent |
| `post_prompt` | prompt | After the agent answered a prompt |
| `on_error` | error | When the stage attempt fails |
| `on_cancel` | lifecycle | When the stage is cancelled |
| `pre_tool_use` | tool | Before an agent tool is invoked |
| `post_tool_use` | tool | After an agent tool completes |
| `on_message` | message | When the agent sends a message |
| `on_reasoning` | message | When the agent emits reasoning content |
| `on_session_start` | session | When the stage session starts |
| `on_session_idle` | session | When the stage session becomes idle |
| `on_session_error` | session | When the stage session reports an error |
| `on_session_cancelled` | session | When the stage session is stopped by a user |

Workflow hook phases (`workflow.hooks[].phase`):

| Phase | Category | When |
|---|---|---|
| `on_run_start` | run | When a workflow run starts |
| `on_run_complete` | run | When a workflow run completes |
| `on_run_failed` | run | When a workflow run fails |
| `on_run_cancelled` | run | When a workflow run is cancelled |
| `pre_clone` | git | Before the run prepares its codebases |
| `post_clone` | git | After the run prepared its codebases |
| `pre_commit` | git | Before post-processing commits |
| `post_commit` | git | After post-processing committed |
| `on_pr_created` | git | After post-processing opened a pull request |
| `on_preprocessing_complete` | orchestration | After the preprocessing steps complete |
| `on_postprocessing_start` | orchestration | Before the post-processing steps start |
| `on_all_stages_scheduled` | orchestration | After every root stage has been scheduled |
| `on_stage_completed` | stage | When any stage completes |
| `on_stage_failed` | stage | When any stage fails |
| `on_parallel_join` | stage | When parallel branches join |

## Budgets

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `maxTurns` | integer (≥1, ≤100000) |  |  | Harness turns (one per usage report) |
| `maxCostUsd` | number (>0, ≤100000) |  |  | Provider-reported cost in USD |
| `maxWallClockMs` | integer (≥1000, ≤604800000) |  |  | Wall clock, excluding time parked for a human |
| `maxTokens` | integer (≥1, ≤10000000000) |  |  | Input plus output tokens reported by the provider |

- `workflow.budget` caps the whole run: when it is exhausted, no new stage starts and the run pauses
  (`budget_exhausted`) for an operator.
- A stage `budget` caps one stage; a `loop` or `map` budget is cumulative over its iterations or items; a
  `subworkflow` budget is the child run's share.
- Exhausting a budget never counts as success. `maxCostUsd` only fires on providers that report cost; pair it
  with `maxTurns` or `maxTokens` (see `agents-and-models.md`).
- `workflow.maxParallel` bounds the stages running at once (engine default 4).

## Outputs, tags and project

- `workflow.outputs` names results as expressions over top-level stages (`{"verdict":
  "stages.review.output.verdict"}`). A parent workflow reads them through a `subworkflow` stage's output.
- `tags` are free labels; `projectId` ties the workflow to a project (null or omitted: global). The draft tools
  set the project from the caller when you omit it.
